payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the performance differences between the DICTA test set and the new test set, particularly regarding character accuracy (CHA) and word accuracy (WOR).

claims.text: The NAKDIMON system outperforms others in character-level metrics but not in word-level metrics, indicating a potential reason for the difference in CHA and WOR scores.
Differences in training data, such as not being trained on the DICTA portion, may contribute to performance discrepancies between the two test sets.
NAKDIMON's errors are often due to its inability to detect certain morphological features, affecting its performance on the WOR metric compared to CHA.
